description: This Swift source file defines types and logic for locating, querying, and interpreting the runtime environment specifically for a Node.js runtime within the OpenClaw project. It includes structures for representing runtime versions and resolutions, logic for finding executables and parsing version strings, and error handling related to runtime discovery failures.

classes.name: RuntimeVersion
classes.description: Represents a semantic version with major, minor, and patch components, and includes comparison and parsing logic.

classes.name: RuntimeResolution
classes.description: Contains information about a specific runtime's kind, path, and version.

classes.name: RuntimeResolutionError
classes.description: Enumerates possible errors encountered during runtime resolution, such as not found, unsupported version, or parse errors.

methods.name: from(string:)
methods.description: Parses a version string into a RuntimeVersion object if possible.

methods.name: resolve(searchPaths:)
methods.description: Attempts to locate the node runtime in given search paths, verify its version, and returns success or detailed failure.

methods.name: describeFailure(_:)
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of a RuntimeResolutionError.
